description: [RFI] Gianni Infantino's bid to remain the head of world football's governing body Fifa gathered strength on Friday after backing from African executives and reports that a potential rival was pulling out of the race for the job as the game's most powerful administrator.
title: Africa: African Football Chiefs Back Infantino to Remain As FIFA Boss

description: [Bird Story Agency] Guinean textile entrepreneur Mariama Camara is moving from promoting African textiles globally to building the institutions behind the industry. Through the Institute of African Textiles, she is pushing for greater ownership, protection and commercial value for the knowledge held by African makers.
title: Africa: Guinean Entrepreneur Mariama Camara Promotes African Textiles Worldwide
